_comment: Copy this file to outreach_config.json and edit. Secrets (API keys, passwords) go in environment variables, NOT here.
_business_hours_note: Calls only trigger Mon-Fri within this hour window. Leads with a phone number found outside this window go to data/manual_followup.csv instead of being skipped forever.
_pacing_note: max_calls_per_run is a safety cap so a bad config can't dial your whole list at once. Raise it only after a few good live runs. seconds_between_calls spaces the calls out so you aren't running dozens of simultaneous conversations.
company_postal_address: Tech Bros Website Studio, 123 Your Street, Your City, TX 75407
_email_note: enable_email is OFF by default. US CAN-SPAM requires a working opt-out and a real physical postal address on commercial email — outreach.py appends both automatically, but you must put your real address in company_postal_address before switching this on. Emailing addresses scraped off websites also carries real deliverability risk to your Gmail account; consider a proper email service once you scale.
email_body_template:
Hey {business_name} team,

I came across your business while looking at local companies and noticed you might not have a website up, or it could use a refresh.

We build websites for small businesses, and can also add in AI tools if you're interested — things like a chatbot that answers customer questions on your site, or a voice assistant that helps with scheduling, all running automatically in the background.

Would you be open to a free, no-pressure 15-minute chat to see if it's a good fit? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Tech Bros Website Studio
techbros.websitestudio@gmail.com
_smtp_note: Default works with Gmail. You must use a Gmail 'App Password' (not your normal password) — generate one at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords. Set it as the EMAIL_APP_PASSWORD environment variable, and your Gmail address as EMAIL_ADDRESS.
